version_policy: Pinned historical commits, not claimed to be latest. Original bytes, licenses and path structure preserved.

provenance_verification.method: Connected GitHub public pinned Git trees/contents; local canonical Git blob SHA-1 compared per file, then SHA-256 recorded. Existing snapshot used only for matching blobs; mismatching Windows-CRLF bytes re-read as base64 from the same pinned commit.
provenance_verification.runtime_execution: No upstream scripts or agent specifications executed; no framework, service, package install or global registration.

sources.support_status: All blobs in selected source directories and the applicable license included; cross-skill/tool/project references are external and not activated.
